title: Account Executive
description:
Roles and Responsibilities 
Job Overview 
 We are looking for a detail-oriented and organized Accounts Executive to manage the companys day-to-day accounting operations, billing, financial entries and documentation. The candidate will be responsible for maintaining accurate financial records and ensuring smooth daily accounting activities. 
 Key Responsibilities 
 * Manage daily accounting entries and bookkeeping. * Prepare sales invoices, purchase bills and quotations. * Record daily sales and purchase transactions. * Maintain cash, bank and ledger entries. * Handle customer and supplier account records. * Manage purchase invoices, sales bills and debit/credit notes. * Maintain accounts receivable and payable records. * Perform bank reconciliation and ledger reconciliation. * Coordinate with customers and suppliers regarding billing and payment-related queries. * Maintain proper documentation of all financial transactions. * Assist in GST-related entries, documentation and reports. * Prepare daily and monthly accounting reports.

Key Skills: Tally,Gst,Taxation,Accounts receivable,Bank reconciliation,Receivable,Payables,General
